title: TIME: Temporal-Sensitive Multi-Dimensional Instruction Tuning and Robust Benchmarking for Video-LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating video models on temporal reasoning tasks using only a single static frame or completely black frames (blind setting) to detect reliance on static visual heuristics or language priors instead of actual temporal understanding.

Analyzing dataset answer distributions and employing debiasing strategies such as downsampling frequently occurring actions, balancing temporal locations (start, middle, end), and using reversed videos to prevent models from exploiting inherent spatial or temporal patterns in the training data.
